ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the image is a beetle, the right side of the body has brown elytra, the front part has a green, glossy head and thorax, and there are multiple letter labels and leader lines around it. The letter G is located on the left side of the beetle, and the horizontal leader line beside it points from G to the green shiny head area at the front end of the beetle. Reasoning: According to the illustrated labeling rules, the letters and leader lines indicate the body parts they point to. G's leader line does not point to a leg or the brown elytra, but points to the front green shiny head, therefore G represents shiny green head.
